 November 3

 FPLReactions 
 Share:
 With the UCL Fantasy deadline approaching, our resident experts are finalising their chips and transfers. 
 Here, they reveal their 15-man teams, explain the key decisions behind their selections and discuss their plans for the fourth round and the long term. 
 Our six-strong team are serial top 1k finishers in UCL Fantasy, so they know their stuff. 
 Remember, managers still putting the finishing touches to their squads can also use our UCL Fantasy Toolkit . 
 There’s free stuff in there for every UCL manager but, as ever,  Chief Scout Members  can dig even deeper. 
 From player points projections  and  underlying statistics  to the  Fixture Ticker,   Rate My UCL Team feature and  Draft Tool , it’s all here to help you build your Matchday 4 squads.
